name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid for picking one date.
a11y: role="grid" with column headers; one day is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the start and end of the week, PageUp/PageDown by month.
Each day button has a full date name; the selected day has aria-pressed and today has aria-current="date".

props.name: value
props.description: The selected date when controlled; `null` means none. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially selected date when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the date the user picks.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date; earlier days are disabled.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date; later days are disabled.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for month and day names.
